claim_summary: For the vector \(p\)-Laplacian Duffing system with \(p>2\), every local periodic-solution selection near a nondegenerate averaged state has the same two-sided leading profile \(\operatorname{sgn}(\varepsilon)|\varepsilon|^{1/(p-1)}\mathcal K(e-\bar e)\). Nonconstant forcing therefore gives exact fractional-power displacement and rules out differentiability at the parameter origin.
integrity: The proof uses the source's exact complementary equation, exact odd homogeneity of the periodic \(p\)-Laplacian inverse, convergence of every local degree-produced solution to the averaged state, and the derivative identity showing that the mean correction annihilates the leading profile. No numerical experiment or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result does not assert uniqueness or global continuation of the local solutions, does not resolve smaller-order separation among different selections, and excludes constant forcing, \(p=2\), and \(1<p<2\).
title: Two-sided cusp law for local p-Laplacian periodic responses
